question: Mysterium VPN residential claim: can the class be measured? The vendor's public discovery API labels each node ip_type, ISP and ASN but publishes no node IP. A measured check needs a connection through a Plus plan and a registry lookup of the exit address, which needs an account and a payment.
why: The claim '7,500+ residential IPs' is a vendor claim with a vendor-published label. An unfiltered read of the discovery API on 2026-11-04 returned 11,754 WireGuard nodes, 7,053 labelled residential across 118 countries; a residential-filtered read minutes later returned 7,384. The 8 MB body is above the 1 MiB limit for a registered probe body, so those counts are not cited in the record. unverified: behind a sign-up.
